title: corominas.boundary
summary:
## Corominas selection rule

Use only two to four capability blocks in one resume. Choose the blocks that directly prove the job description's central buying criteria. Do not overload a three-month role by listing the entire system portfolio.

Every bullet should expose a transferable engineering pattern unless the job explicitly rewards the original operating domain. Reconstruct the work around multi-tenancy, validation, human control, orchestration, escalation, cost control, generated infrastructure, or hardening.
